  screenshot it.

  I found 128 boards in the canvas index, but I haven't exported any PNGs or written any files. The canvas files I downloaded are in the scratchpad only. I don't have the host's support.js, so
  rendering the board sources locally would only approximate the canvas. Your brief says never to approximate a board.

  I asked how to get real PNGs, with three options:
  - Sign in (recommended): you sign in to claude.ai in this task's browser, and I continue from there.
  - Manual export: you export the PNGs from the canvas yourself and drop a zip in the worktree.
  - Local render: I render the board sources locally with the published runtime, accepting that it may differ from the canvas.

  Which one do you want?
